items.item_text: High School Graduate, General Studies, and Previous staffing office experience, upon hire

Adheres to established Hospital/departmental policies and procedures, objectives, Quality Assessment and Improvement Program, legal, safety, environmental, infection control standards, and the Patient's Bill of Rights.
Provides adequate staffing of nursing personnel for all shifts based on pre-established schedules, staffing guidelines, and direction from the Department Director or designee.

Coordinates the staffing requirements of each unit based on immediate changes due to the need for replacement staff, patient acuity, and census under the direction of the Department Director or designee.
Demonstrates an understanding of organizational structure and utilizes appropriate channels of communication.
Requisitions supplies and equipment, maintenance and repair services, and prepares related forms. Maintains stock and equipment at predetermined PAR levels.
Establishes and maintains interpersonal relationships with patients, visitors, physicians, and Hospital personnel, while maintaining confidentiality of patient information.
